description_compelling: A foreign state deploys military force inside another sovereign territory — direct combat, contracted irregulars, or a coercive presence sustained over months. Regulatory quality, gender-distributed power, and fiscal-capacity scores drift downward across nearly two decades before the boots arrive. The countries that match best are weak states adjacent to great-power rivalries.
